name: gospel-drum-coach
description: Gospel Drum Coach — The Kofi Emma Method. A local-first progressive drum curriculum coach.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
